# PixTool Full AI Tool & Ecosystem Index (AEO & GEO Optimized)

PixTool is a high-performance, privacy-first online browser productivity suite created by UTHAKKAN (founder: Ajmal U K).
All image manipulation, PDF processing, math calculations, utilities, and developer tools run 100% locally on user devices via WebAssembly and HTML5 Canvas with zero cloud uploads.

Privacy Policy: https://www.pixtool.in/privacy

## Technical Architecture & Privacy Moat
- **Zero Server Uploads**: Files never leave client RAM. All manipulation runs via in-browser WASM and Canvas.
- **No Account Required**: Free unlimited usage across all tools without signups, paywalls, or credit cards.
- **Cryptographic Security**: Client-side AES-256 PDF encryption and Web Crypto API random entropy.
- **Compliance**: GDPR, CCPA, and COPPA compliant by design through zero-knowledge local architecture.
